room-receipt.help: Figures are copied from the code receipt. The original calculation remains below.
room-receipt.discountRule: discount in basis points, rounded half up to the minor unit
room-receipt.none: no tax added, because tax is not turned on for this price
room-receipt.single: tax in basis points, rounded half up to the minor unit
room-receipt.split: CGST and SGST each at half the rate, each rounded half up to the minor unit, so their sum can differ by one from a single rate
room-receipt.igst: IGST at the full rate, rounded half up to the minor unit
room-receipt.lut: export of services under LUT, zero-rated
room-receipt.nativeSplit: {base}, plus CGST at {cgstRate}% ({cgst}) and SGST at {sgstRate}% ({sgst}) = {total}.
room-receipt.assumedState: Place of supply taken as your own state.
